mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.host_user_nickname AS nickname, p.name, p.description, p.place_type AS placeType, p.allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, p.allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, p.allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, p.provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, p.provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, p.provides_yard AS providesYard, p.provides_walk AS providesWalk, p.hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, pa.latitude AS latitude, pa.longitude AS longitude, TRUE AS bookmarked FROM bookmarks b JOIN places p ON p.id = b.place_id LEFT JOIN place_addresses pa ON pa.place_id = p.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.is_visible = TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC
